prompt:
Design a landscape certificate of completion on cream paper with a fine navy and gold guilloche border.

Text, top to bottom, all centred, exactly as written:
"CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION" (small caps, letter-spaced, navy)
"This certifies that" (small italic serif)
"Maya Okonkwo" (large elegant script, gold)
"has successfully completed the course" (small italic serif)
"Foundations of Visual Design" (bold serif, navy)
"12 September 2026" (small serif)

Bottom-left, a signature line with "Course Director" beneath it. Bottom-right, an embossed gold circular seal with a laurel motif and no text inside. Balanced whitespace, nothing else on the page.
